title: IBIH Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
IBIH Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. is a major Chinese aerogel producer founded in 2015 and focused on the large-scale industrialization of aerogel technologies. The company operates across thermal management solutions, energy-efficiency solutions, and advanced materials solutions, with a particularly strong position in EV battery thermal-protection materials.

Company Overview

IBIH states that it combines independent R&D, intelligent manufacturing, and application-driven product development across multiple aerogel business lines. The company publicly emphasizes battery safety materials, aerogel insulation for buildings, and engineered solutions for industrial and cryogenic environments.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: China with wider global partner and export reach through multiple sales centers.
  • Focus Areas: EV battery thermal management, building and industrial energy-efficiency insulation, and advanced aerogel material development.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Fire-resistant aerogel insulation pads and blankets
  • Ceramic insulation tape and nano insulation panels
  • Aerogel sponge and fire-resistant coatings
  • PI aerogel insulation film
  • Aerogel granules/powder and cryogenic blankets
  • Building insulation blankets and panels
  • Public Capacity: 35,000 m³ of aerogels/composite materials and 300 million+ battery insulation pads annually.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Sites: Cangzhou Lingang Economic and Technological Development Zone, Hebei, and Xuchang, Henan, China.
  • International Certifications: The company publicly states it operates quality, environmental, and occupational health & safety management systems; specific certificate numbers are not clearly listed on the English pages reviewed.
  • Official Website: http://ibih.cn
